hostSkill.missing: {skill} is not installed (looked in: {roots}). The delegate opens its pull request through it; install the bundled skills with `pnpm run install-skills -- <project>` in the Lantern repo.

preflight.pushNoPullRequest: not needed for Delivery push: no pull request is opened, so no host skill or account is required
preflight.unreadableCheck: {skill} check printed something that is not JSON: {text}
preflight.hostSkillOk: {skill} at {script}. Put it in the brief as: Host skill: {skill}
preflight.extraSkillsLine: the delegate slot of the extensions config resolves: {names}. The delegate gets them from its protocol, which runs required-skills.mjs
preflight.switchedOffSkillsLine: the {slot} slot of the extensions config switches off: {names}. required-skills.mjs leaves them out of the {slot} list, so nothing demands them
preflight.reviewerExtraSkillsLine: the reviewer slot of the extensions config resolves: {names}. The reviewer gets them from its agent definition, which runs required-skills.mjs --role reviewer
preflight.identityMismatch: {problems}. Fix git config (a repo-local `git config user.*`, with the user's agreement) before dispatching.
preflight.identityNoEmail: no commit e-mail found: the Lantern profile for this project did not give one and GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL is not set, so commits would fall back to git config ({author}). Add the account in Lantern (command palette, Integrations; a GitHub account needs a public e-mail) or set GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL.

identityFrom.profile: commits authored as {author}, the e-mail from the Lantern profile
identityFrom.env: commits authored as {author}, the e-mail from GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL

prCreate.detachedHead: Detached HEAD — check out a branch or pass --branch.
prCreate.noDefaultBranch: Could not determine the default branch. Pass --target.
prCreate.badBranch: The branch "{branch}" is not a conventional name: a delegate pushes only to {types} branches.
prCreate.identityAdvice: Tell the user exactly this. Do not edit global git config; a repo-local `git config user.*` only if they agree.
prCreate.commitsCorrectNote: (the commits on the branch are correct; this affects future commits)

preferences.usage:
usage: node preferences.mjs get delivery [--project <dir>]
       node preferences.mjs set delivery <{values}> [--project <dir>]
get prints the stored value, or "unset" when none is stored.
preferences.badKey: "{key}" is not a preference; the only one is {known}.
preferences.badValue: "{value}" is not a delivery; use one of: {values}.
preferences.unreadable: {file} is not valid JSON ({reason}); fix or remove it, nothing was changed.
preferences.notAnObject: {file} does not hold a JSON object; nothing was changed.
preferences.storedInvalid: {file} holds delivery "{value}", which is not one of: {values}. Ask the user again and set it.

identity.partialProfile: The commit identity has no name or no e-mail; the missing part comes from git config.

source.profile: the Lantern profile chosen for this project

skillLinker.missing: {path} does not exist, so it is not an executable file.
skillLinker.notFile: {path} is neither a file nor a folder.
skillLinker.notExecutable: {path} is a file but not executable; give it execute permission.
skillLinker.noCore: {path} is executable but the skills repo beside it has no "core" folder.
skillLinker.folderNoExecutable: The folder {path} holds no executable file, so it has no skill linker.
skillLinker.folderNoCore: The folder {path} has executable files but no "core" folder beside them, so none is the skill linker.
skillLinker.folderSeveral: The folder {path} holds several skill linkers ({names}); enter the path of one of them.

extensions.badSlot: "{slot}" is not an extension slot; use one of: {slots}.
extensions.badName: "{name}" is not a plain skill folder name.
extensions.locked: "{name}" is a core skill and cannot be added as an extra.
extensions.droppedLocked: Always-on skills listed as extras were dropped: {names}.
extensions.droppedOff: Skills that cannot be switched off were dropped from the off list: {names}.
extensions.notSwitchable: "{name}" cannot be switched off for the {slot} slot; only the skills that shape how it works can.
extensions.offNotAnObject: The "off" key in {file} must hold an object of slot names and skill lists.
extensions.badSkillLinker: The skillLinker setting must be an absolute path to the script, not {value}.
extensions.notAList: The "{slot}" slot in {file} must be a list of skill names.
extensions.unreadable: {file} is not valid JSON ({reason}); fix or remove it, nothing was changed.
extensions.notAnObject: {file} must hold a JSON object; fix or remove it, nothing was changed.
extensions.damaged: The extensions config is ignored and treated as empty: {reason}
extensions.projectDamaged: The project extensions file is ignored and treated as empty; the global extras still apply: {reason}
extensions.projectDroppedLocked: Always-on skills listed as extras in {file} were dropped: {names}.
extensions.projectNotAFolder: {folder} is not a folder, so no project extras were written.
extensions.projectUnsafe: {folder} is not a plain folder or file (a symbolic link, for example), so nothing was written there.
extensions.skipped: Configured {slot} extra "{name}" does not resolve in the skill registry ({roots}); skipped.
